project_description: Replace Go-LIP stream-time financial accounting with domain-neutral Turn/Leg Usage Records and a durable Bun-backed double-entry billing journal. Before upstream work, calculate a pessimistic maximum customer charge and atomically record an authorization hold against prepaid funds or a postpaid credit line. Execute with no financial mutation, then persist one immutable A-leg Turn Usage Record containing every billable B-leg and its provider/model evidence. Post-turn processing calculates customer revenue and per-B-leg operator cost, posts balanced financial and authorization journal entries, records point-in-time balance/reserved/available snapshots, closes the hold, and updates rebuildable materialized account state. Journal replay must reconstruct account state and support reconciliation/recovery.
